subject: Decision Making
subcategory: Famous Decisions That Changed the World
title: Fleming Notices the Mold
description: A quick win: understand Fleming Notices the Mold.

hook.text: Alexander Fleming left a petri dish uncovered during vacation. Mold grew on it and killed the bacteria around it.

buildup.text: Most scientists would have thrown away the contaminated dish. Fleming chose to investigate the mold instead.

discovery.text: The mold produced penicillin. It became the first antibiotic and has saved over 200 million lives.

twist.text: Two other scientists had seen the same effect before Fleming. They discarded their dishes and missed the discovery.

climax.text: Fleming's decision was noticing. The choice to investigate an anomaly instead of discarding it changed medicine forever.

punchline.text: Others threw it out. Fleming looked closer. Noticing is a decision.

quiz.question: What decision set Fleming apart from other scientists who saw the same mold effect?
options: He chose to investigate the anomaly instead of discarding it
